verdict.rationale: Self-hosting gives operators full control over their own data lifecycle (hatchet-docs-8/17), and the pricing page mentions a '7-day data retention' tier for enterprise plans (hatchet-docs-19), implying some retention configurability, but there is no documented user-facing API or setting for deletion/retention policies, and community notes even describe past difficulties bulk-deleting data due to UUID primary keys (hatchet-comm-12). Missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion API or settings, documentation on how users purge or expire data, and independent confirmation these controls work as intended.
